==Acquisition==
*Talk to [[Kodan]] [Dwarven Recruitment Officer] in [[Gunnar's Hold]] after attaining the first rank of the [[Deldrimor rank|Deldrimor title]].

==Notes==
*This cannot be equipped on the [[skill bar]]. While a [[character]] displays the Deldrimor title, this effect is applied to that character and all of their [[hero]]es.
*The skill's damage is not [[life stealing]], but is either armor-ignoring untyped damage (possibly [[chaos damage]] or [[dark damage]]) or direct [[health loss]].
*Stout-Hearted works on any successful skill activation, including [[block]]ed and [[fail]]ed [[attack skill]]s.
*This skill affects whatever destroyer you have selected when activating a skill. The skill itself does not need to actually interact with the destroyer in any way to trigger Stout Hearted. For example, using [[Animate Bone Horror]] with a destroyer targeted will work.
